nodes.label: Corpo Lingo (product)
nodes.rationale: Corporate-language translator: casual text is rewritten into professional corporate language by an LLM, chosen by mode and formality.

nodes.label: Translate Request Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: POST /api/v1/translate: optionalAuthenticate -> validateTranslation -> controller (cache lookup -> translateWithFallback on miss -> cache store -> persist if authenticated).

nodes.label: JWT httpOnly Cookie Auth
nodes.rationale: Stateless JWT in an httpOnly cookie named token (7d, SameSite=lax, Secure in prod) so the browser never handles the raw token and cross-site POST is blocked.

nodes.label: API Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: 100 req/day authenticated vs 10 req/day guests; key derived from the JWT cookie, guest IPs normalised via ipKeyGenerator to stop IPv6 address-hopping.

nodes.label: Shared Types Contract
nodes.rationale: packages/shared is the single source of truth for request/response shapes so backend and frontend can't drift on enum values or payloads.

nodes.label: pnpm + Nx Monorepo
nodes.rationale: pnpm workspaces for deps + Nx for cached build/test/lint orchestration across backend, frontend, shared.

nodes.label: Pluggable AI Provider System
nodes.rationale: Active provider chosen by AI_PROVIDER; ai.factory routes to groq/openai/gemini/ollama, all behind one interface.

nodes.label: TranslationService Interface
nodes.rationale: translateText(text, mode, formality) -> { translatedText, usage, model }; the contract every provider satisfies.

nodes.label: Provider Fallback on Rate Limit
nodes.rationale: translateWithFallback retries with FALLBACK_PROVIDER only when isRateLimitError() (429/quota); any other error is re-thrown.

nodes.label: Prompt Building
nodes.rationale: buildSystemPrompt(mode, formality) composes general + mode + formality rule blocks; temperature scales 0.2->0.4 with formality.

nodes.label: Translation Mode
nodes.rationale: email (greeting+closing), documentation (instructional, concise), formal (neutral, no greeting).

nodes.label: Formality Level
nodes.rationale: low (light polish), medium (clearly professional), high (highly formal, structured).

nodes.label: Lazy Provider Client Init
nodes.rationale: Clients constructed on first translate call so the app boots and tests run without keys; a missing key surfaces as 503 at request time, not startup.

nodes.label: Redis Translation Cache
nodes.rationale: Key = SHA-256(text|mode|formality), 30-day TTL, provider-agnostic; all calls try/catch so a Redis outage degrades to no-cache, never an error.

nodes.label: Express Middleware Stack
nodes.rationale: Order matters: trust proxy -> helmet -> cors -> morgan -> cookieParser -> json(10kb) -> rate limiter -> routes -> notFound -> errorHandler (last).

nodes.label: Central Error Handler
nodes.rationale: Maps thrown errors to JSON: OpenAI->502, API key->503, else statusCode/500; stack only in development, generic message for 5xx in production.

nodes.label: Password Reset Email Delivery
nodes.rationale: Transport chosen at send time: Resend HTTP API in prod, Ethereal preview inbox in dev, skip+log if neither configured.

nodes.label: Password Reset Flow
nodes.rationale: forgotPassword always returns 200 (anti-enumeration), stores a SHA-256 token hash (1h TTL); resetPassword validates unused+unexpired then single-uses it.

nodes.label: Database Schema
nodes.rationale: No migration framework; initDb() runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for all three tables on boot. Schema changes go in initDb().

nodes.label: users table
nodes.rationale: password_hash nullable for Google-only accounts; google_sub UNIQUE.

nodes.label: translations table
nodes.rationale: UUID id, FK to users, indexed (user_id, created_at DESC); only authenticated users' translations are stored.

nodes.label: password_reset_tokens table
nodes.rationale: Stores only the SHA-256 token hash, 1h TTL, single-use (used_at).

nodes.label: REST API (/api/v1)
nodes.rationale: All responses JSON with success:boolean; auth via httpOnly token cookie; consistent error/validation envelope.

nodes.label: React SPA Frontend
nodes.rationale: React 19 + Vite + React Router 6 + TanStack Query; talks to a relative /api proxied by Vite in dev and Nginx in Docker.

nodes.label: Google Sign-In (Auth Code flow)
nodes.rationale: GIS popup returns a short-lived authorization code; backend exchanges it for tokens with the client secret (backend-only) and issues the session cookie.

nodes.label: Dark Mode (next-themes)
nodes.rationale: next-themes class strategy toggles .dark on <html>, persists to localStorage, respects prefers-color-scheme.

nodes.label: Docker Deployment
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage builds; backend as Node service, frontend as static files served by Nginx which proxies /api to the backend.

nodes.label: VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID Build Arg
nodes.rationale: Vite inlines VITE_* at build time, so the public Google client ID is passed as a Docker build arg / CI variable, never read at runtime.

nodes.label: Local Dev Infra (DB required)
nodes.rationale: pnpm dev needs Postgres because initDb() blocks startup until it connects; docker-compose.dev.yml supplies postgres+redis with host ports.

nodes.label: Corpo Lingo App Icon (512px)
nodes.rationale: PWA install icon: a stylized light-blue crystalline quill/feather emblem centered on a dark navy gradient rounded square.

nodes.label: Corpo Lingo App Icon (192px)
nodes.rationale: Smaller PWA icon variant of the same quill emblem (not individually inspected; inferred to match the 512px icon by standard PWA pairing).

nodes.label: Favicon (SVG)
nodes.rationale: Browser-tab favicon for the SPA (vector, not individually inspected).

nodes.label: Icons SVG
nodes.rationale: SVG asset in the frontend public dir (contents not inspected; likely brand/icon artwork).

nodes.label: Corpo Lingo Quill Emblem (brand mark)
nodes.rationale: The product's visual identity: a crystalline quill/feather on navy, evoking writing/polishing text — the core Corpo Lingo action.
